title: The Show Must Go On!
description: A team of organizers runs a large annual technology conference, bringing together thousands of developers, technology professionals, and industry experts.

Each year features a new lineup of speakers, talks, and activities. The organizers need a platform to manage the conference, keep attendees informed, and support interactions between speakers and participants.
Early-bird ticket sales open in three months.
The platform must also maintain an archive of previous editions, allowing visitors to explore past schedules, speakers, and presentations.

Requirements: organizers and speakers can manage talks, schedules, room assignments, and conference information; attendees can explore the program, interact with talks, provide feedback, and receive important updates; visitors can explore previous editions, including their programs, speakers, and presentations; all capabilities must be usable on mobile devices, including during the conference; the platform must remain useful during periods of high demand and unreliable venue connectivity
Users: thousands of attendees, hundreds of speakers, dozens of staff
